_readme: Categories for the split Chat windows (App toolbar 'Chat' opens one window per category). A tag-stripped chat line is tested against each category's 'match' regexes IN ORDER; the first category with any regex hitting wins. A line matching nothing lands in the 'Other' window -- watch that one and add rules here. 'deny' regexes drop a line from ALL windows (use for combat the parser can't shape -- damageless/absorbed hits -- leaking in as chat). .NET regex syntax, case-sensitive. Reorder / add / delete freely and relaunch -- no rebuild. Set 'categories' to [] (or delete this file) for a single combined Chat window.
